fields.gold: Dallas Independent School District
fields.output: Dallas Independent School District

Dallas Independent School District’s “Student and Staff Computing Devices” bid (JA-207652; SOURCING #168884; 00004079100) lists 50,000 each of two student Chromebook models and student tablets; 5,000 student Windows laptops; 10,000 each of two staff laptop tiers; and 5,000 each of two staff desktop tiers and two monitor types. Bids were due July 9, 2024, at 2:00 PM CST; electronic submission through iSupplier was preferred, sealed paper submissions were permitted, and fax or email submissions were not accepted. The proposed term was three years, with two successive one-year extensions by mutual consent, not to exceed five years; the listed cooperatives were EPCNT and CTPA. Required deployment services included software installation, asset tagging and reporting, etching on laptops, device setup, and delivery to varied locations. Required documentation included completed M/WBE forms, a signed W9, applicable Form 1295, acknowledged addenda, and a detailed shipment-tracking and deployment plan. Prime vendors must pay subcontractor, supplier, or entity invoices, including retainage, within 10 days of receiving district payment and submit an M/WBE Pay Activity Report with each pay application or as requested, along with required proof of payments.
fields.reason: judge: The summary correctly covers the bid identity, quantities, deadline, submission methods, term, and deployment services, but omits the pre-bid meeting, delivery timing, contact details, device specifications, and several required documents.

The State of Maryland Treasurer’s Office’s bid “Dell Laptops w/Extended Warranty” (#E20P4600040; BPM044557; 00004079359) uses the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract, 060B5400007. It calls for 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4); the laptops include Windows 11 Pro and a three-year Dell Limited Hardware Warranty extension. Electronic submissions through eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) were due June 10, 2024, at 2:00 PM EDT, and quotes must remain valid for at least 90 days after that date. Delivery is required within 45 days of award to 80 Calvert Street, Room 109, Annapolis, MD 21401. The Master Contractor must be an authorized Dell reseller; a Mercury Affidavit is required, a manufacturer or distributor Letter of Authorization may be requested, and a warranty certificate or affidavit must be presented upon award. Invoices must be emailed to STOaccountspayable@treasurer.state.md.us within 10 days of equipment delivery and include the specified contractor, purchase-order, invoice, delivery, and serial-number information.
